images.title: A construction company is hiring an *HR Administrator*

images.name: posting
images.title: HR Administrator
duties: Coordinate employee onboarding in BambooHR and track required documents
Arrange medical tests, drug and alcohol tests, criminal record checks and clearances
Maintain onboarding and clearance tracking with status updates to project teams
Enter and maintain employee information in the payroll system
Coordinate benefits enrollment and answer routine benefits questions
Support recruitment and project workforce reporting
images.qualifications: Administrative experience, ideally in HR. Strong organization and attention to detail. Proficient in Excel, Word and Outlook.
images.note: Duties condensed from a real Indeed posting. Company name and address removed.

images.name: quote
images.text: Six duties on this posting, and all six are paperwork moving between *BambooHR, payroll, a testing clinic and the job sites.*

images.name: breakdown
images.title: What the AI Employee does *in each duty*
rows: Creates the employee record, sends the packet, tracks every signature and chases what's missing until the file is complete.
Medicals, drug tests and record checks
Books each test with the provider, texts the worker where and when, and logs the outcome when it arrives.
Keeps one live tracker per project and tells the site the moment a worker is cleared to start.
Enters new-hire details and checks them against the offer letter. Any change to pay waits for a person.
Answers routine questions from the plan booklet, 24/7, and walks new hires through enrollment.
Screens applicants against the must-haves, books interviews and sends the weekly headcount report.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A Monday for the *AI HR Administrator*
rows: A superintendent texts: two new labourers start next Monday on the north site. It creates both in BambooHR and sends their onboarding packets.
Books both pre-access drug and alcohol tests at the nearest clinic and texts each worker the address and time.
Chases last week's hire for a missing TD1 and void cheque. Second reminder, logged.
An employee asks if physio is covered for their spouse. It answers from the benefits booklet and sends the claim form.
A clearance comes back. It updates the tracker and tells the site super the worker can start Monday.
A background check comes back with a flag. It takes no action and sends it to the HR manager.
A pay rate in the payroll system doesn't match the offer letter. It holds the record for approval.
Sends the weekly workforce report: headcount by project, pending clearances and open roles.
images.source: Example day, built from the duties in the posting

images.name: setup
images.title: How it's *set up*
steps: Start from this posting, then sit with whoever does the job today. Every checklist, form and 'we always do it this way' gets written down.
BambooHR, the payroll system, email and text, the testing provider and the clearance tracker. Without tools it can only talk about the work.
Onboarding steps per role, the benefits booklet, clearance rules per site and the tone the company uses with its crews.
Paperwork and reminders it does alone. Bookings it does and reports. Pay, discipline and anything sensitive go to a person first.
For the first stretch it drafts and a person approves. As the log shows it gets things right, it takes on more.
Someone reviews the log, fixes anything it got wrong and updates it when policies, benefits or software change.
